description: Source code for DOM element handling and interaction within Playwright's server-side implementation, including classes for element handles, execution contexts, and utility functions for DOM operations.

classes.name: FrameExecutionContext

classes.description: Represents a handle to a DOM element, providing methods for interaction and querying.
